name: Clojure
description: A dynamic, functional Lisp for the JVM.
summary: The Clojure contributor agreement bans code generated by large language models or similar technology as code for Clojure, and it does not address AI-written issues or summaries.

evidence.quote: Code generated by a large language model or similar technology, such as Anthropic’s Claude, GitHub/Microsoft’s Copilot, OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Facebook/Meta’s Code Llama et al, is not compliant with the covenants and representations of Clojure’s Contributor’s Agreement
and is thus not acceptable as code for Clojure.
